I couldn't set up the 09:00 digest. My scheduler is blocked: every request to it fails with "gateway requires credentials," so I can't create or list recurring jobs. I haven't made any promise that it will run.

I can see #coastal-team and you're a member, so the content side is fine. When the schedule is working, I'll check the channel each morning and leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values) unless they concern an account you own. Those go only to the account owner, Anselm, and June.

The fix is on the Gateway side, so an admin needs to restore its credentials. Once that's done, let me know and I'll set up the digest. Until then, I can post a digest for you on request whenever you want one.
